newsitem.title: MEXICO: Consorcio Hogar IPO in Mexico next week-source.
newsitem.headline: Consorcio Hogar IPO in Mexico next week-source.

text.p: Affordable housing builders Consorcio Hogar de Occidente will make an initial public offering on the Mexican Stock Exchange next week, according to a document obtained by Reuters on Tuesday.

The company will offer 35.20 percent of its equity, worth an estimated 207 million pesos, the document said, by placing 21.740 million series B shares, of which 10.870 will be placed through ADRs in the United States.
The offer price per share will be 11.50 pesos, and the offering will have a greenshoe, or allocation for excess subscription, of 3.216 million shares.
The placement agent in Mexico will be the Inverlat brokerage, and Daiwa Securities in the United States.
